_cc_template_ruling_20260821: TEMPLATE 3 — PAID-TRIM COVERED CALLS (principal-ratified 2026-08-21). A covered call is a PAID TRIM ORDER — the sell-side mirror of the 07-30 CSP insight (CSP = paid limit-buy). Authorized ONLY where a trim intention already exists. SIX GATES, all required: (1) COMPLETED POSITION — no pending adds, no resting buy rungs, no active lot-build plan (a TLH core under construction is ineligible: WAL is the named non-example — pricing passed, eligibility failed); (2) STRIKE AT-OR-ABOVE a court-set trim/ladder level — the CC replaces a sell rung that already rests or is doctrinally justified, never a level invented for premium; (3) VRP POSITIVE (underlying IV > RV30) AND liquid chain (OI/spread executability — the KALMAR lesson); (4) MEME/SQUEEZE EXCLUSION and no catalyst inside the tenor unless the ladder itself is explicitly through-the-event (the SLS overrun is the standing lesson: unresolvable-catalyst premium is meme premium); (5) CONTRACTS <= the rung's share count — only lots we would genuinely surrender at the strike; (6) QUALIFIED-CC STRIKE — OTM per the qualified covered call rules so the shares' holding period is NOT suspended; near/in-the-money strikes are barred regardless of premium. TAX LOGIC RATIFIED WITH IT: when the ladder fills, the gain realizes anyway — a CC at the ladder strike realizes the SAME gain plus premium, so the only tax delta vs the free ladder is the premium itself (ST income, accepted as the price of being paid for an order we were resting free) provided gate 6 holds. CADENCE: episodic by construction — pays only when a position approaches its ladder. First calibration point: the 2026-08-21 WAL shadow entry grades 9/18 (a deliberate FAIL case). Nearest live candidate at ratification: MNDY 105sh vs its 108 ladder (marginal, ~19% OTM).
